mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_logs(request_id, order_id, sku_id, quantity, type) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{orderId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, order_id, sku_id, quantity, type, created_at FROM stock_logs WHERE request_id = #{requestId} OR (order_id = #{orderId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND type = #{type}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN request_id = #{requestId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
